notes: Historical period selection: last 3 completed fiscal years available in Roper’s FY2025 Form 10-K (FY2023–FY2025, fiscal year ends Dec 31). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

EBIT definition: modeled as “Income from operations” from Roper’s Consolidated Statements of Earnings (operating income). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

D&A definition: total non-cash depreciation/amortization approximated as Depreciation & amortization of PP&E + Amortization of intangible assets + Amortization of deferred financing costs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

Capex definition: modeled as (Capital expenditures + Capitalized software expenditures) from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows to reflect cash outflows for both tangibles and internally developed software. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

NWC definition: uses Roper’s stated definition (total current assets excluding cash minus total current liabilities excluding debt), producing negative NWC consistent with the company’s asset-light model. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

Investments assumption: set to the 3-year average “Acquisitions of businesses, net of cash acquired” (cash outflow) to roughly align acquisition-related growth with cash deployment in the DCF framework; if your DCF pipeline treats acquisitions separately, set this field to null or 0. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

WACC and terminal multiple: WACC is an estimate (not disclosed in filings). Terminal exit EV/EBITDA multiple set to 14.5 based on Roper’s prevailing valuation range; treat as a modeling choice subject to your discounting/multiple methodology. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rop/statistics/?utm_source=openai))

NOLs: balance and utilization were not extracted from the provided filings sections within this pass; fields set to null. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))
Current price: $353.68 from live quote as of 2026-03-21.

Comps: MarketScreener “fiscal period 2026” EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA, and P/E are used as forward/NTM proxies; if your pipeline requires strict NTM consensus windows, replace with your preferred dataset. catalysts: Reacceleration (or sustained delivery) of organic growth versus the FY2025 organic trajectory, sustaining higher top-line compounding. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/fr/news-release/2026/01/27/3226285/0/en/Roper-Technologies-announces-2025-financial-results.html?utm_source=openai))
Margin upside from continued cost synergies and disciplined integration of acquired platforms. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283525000008/rop-20241231.htm))
Incremental multiple support if forward growth expectations improve and WACC compresses.
company_overview: Roper is a diversified technology company with exposure across Application Software, Network Software, and Technology Enabled Products, with a large recurring-revenue component. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

The company reports an asset-light working-capital profile with consistently negative net working capital as defined in its filings. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

Roper’s business model emphasizes disciplined acquisition-driven growth alongside operating leverage and strong cash generation. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/fr/news-release/2026/01/27/3226285/0/en/Roper-Technologies-announces-2025-financial-results.html?utm_source=openai))
current_context: In its FY2025 results release (Jan 2026), Roper guided 2026 total revenue growth of approximately 8% with organic growth around +5% to +6%. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/fr/news-release/2026/01/27/3226285/0/en/Roper-Technologies-announces-2025-financial-results.html?utm_source=openai))

FY2025 operating income (EBIT proxy) remained highly profitable, supporting a base case of stable-to-improving margins over the forecast horizon. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes a gradual step-down from FY2026 guidance toward a lower long-run rate consistent with a maturing recurring mix. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/fr/news-release/2026/01/27/3226285/0/en/Roper-Technologies-announces-2025-financial-results.html?utm_source=openai))

EBIT margin is modeled to inch upward toward ~0.29 by 2030, reflecting operating leverage and acquisition integration benefits. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

DCF cash conversion is supported by negative net working capital and relatively low maintenance capex versus sales. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))

Terminal valuation is tied to a reasonable software/tech-services exit EV/EBITDA multiple given observed peer forward multiples and Roper’s prevailing valuation range. ([marketscreener.com](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ACI-WORLDWIDE-INC-11158/valuation/))
key_risks: Organic growth deceleration or customer budget pressure could limit revenue compounding and/or margin expansion. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/fr/news-release/2026/01/27/3226285/0/en/Roper-Technologies-announces-2025-financial-results.html?utm_source=openai))

Acquisition execution risk (integration, amortization profile, and synergy realization) may reduce profitability. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882835/000088283526000009/rop-20251231.htm))
Macro/interest-rate changes could increase discount rates, pressuring valuation even with stable fundamentals.
